name: FiveM / RedM
author: panel@example.com
description: FiveM and RedM with txAdmin, made for the panel's FiveM pages (docs/features/fivem.md). Runs on the FiveM image, whose fivem-runtime installs the FXServer build FIVEM_VERSION asks for at every start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# FiveM and RedM install for the panel's FiveM pages (docs/features/fivem.md).
#
# Runs in the FiveM image, the image the server itself runs in, so the artifact the install lays
# down and the one every start keeps up to date come from the same code: fivem-runtime reads
# FIVEM_VERSION (recommended, latest or a build number) and FIVEM_EDITION (legacy or enhanced)
# and installs that build into alpine/.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server

exec fivem-runtime install /mnt/server

variables.name: FiveM Version
variables.description: recommended or latest follows Cfx (every start installs that channel's current build), a build number stays on that build. Set from the Artifacts page.

variables.name: txAdmin Port
variables.description: The port txAdmin's web interface listens on. Give the server a second allocation with this port.

variables.name: FiveM Edition
variables.description: legacy runs FiveM, enhanced runs FiveM for GTAV Enhanced. Set from the Artifacts page.

variables.name: Hosting Provider Name
variables.description: The hosting provider's name txAdmin shows (2 to 16 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, no spaces: the start line passes it unquoted). Put your own in place of example.com.
